families.product_name: ACUSON Sequoia / Sequoia Select / Origin / Origin ICE cardiac AI features (AI Assist, AI Measure, 2D HeartAI, 4D HeartAI, Trace AI, Valves AI)
families.company: Siemens Medical Solutions USA, Inc. (Siemens Healthineers)
families.summary: Siemens ACUSON Sequoia, Sequoia Select, Origin and Origin ICE carry an optional cardiac AI package cleared across four 510(k)s (K232145, K242523, K251481, K260844; openFDA product code IYN; the clearance letters also list QIH). AI Assist places color boxes and Doppler gates on 12 TTE views, AI Measure semi-automates B-mode/Doppler/M-mode measurements, 2D HeartAI and 4D HeartAI contour chambers on 2D and 3D/4D TTE/TEE, Trace AI contours orifice-type structures on MPRs from 3D ICE/TEE/TTE, and Valves AI models the mitral and aortic valves from 3D TEE. The FDA summaries report retrospective verification testing on per-feature test sets of 10-48 patients/exams/studies against 3-examiner references; training-set sizes are not disclosed and no peer-reviewed study of the Sequoia/Origin-cleared features was found.
families.intended_use_quote: The ACUSON Sequoia, Sequoia Select, and Origin will offer an optional cardiac imaging and analysis package with new transducers and software applications with Artificial Intelligent algorithms. The  ACUSON Sequoia, Sequoia Select, and Origin will offer four (4) new software applications (AI Measure, AI Assist, 2D HeartAI, 4D HeartAI) containing Machine Learning that are specifically intended to support cardiac imaging for blood flow, valves and anatomical features and modifies the Indications for Use.
families.indications_for_use_quote: The ACUSON Origin and Origin ICE ultrasound imaging systems are intended to provide images of, or signals from, inside the body by an appropriately trained healthcare professional in a clinical setting for the following applications: Fetal, Abdominal, Pediatric, OB/GYN (useful for visualization of the ovaries, follicles, uterus and other pelvic structures), Cardiac, Transesophageal, Intracardiac, Vascular, Adult Cephalic, and Peripheral Vascular applications. The catheter is intended for intracardiac and intra-luminal visualization of cardiac and great vessel anatomy and physiology as well as visualization of other devices in the heart of adult and pediatric patients. The catheter is intended for imaging guidance only, not treatment delivery, during cardiac interventional percutaneous procedures. The system also provides the ability to measure anatomical structures for fetal, abdominal, pediatric, cardiac, peripheral vessel, and calculation packages that provide information to the clinician that may be used adjunctively with other medical data obtained by a physician for clinical diagnosis purposes.

embedded_ai_features.name: AI Assist
embedded_ai_features.function: Cardiac view classification with automated color Doppler ROI (color box) and spectral Doppler gate placement for 12 standard adult TTE views (1-4 anatomy locations per view, 42 supported placements); in K251481 the view detected by AI Assist automatically launches the relevant AI Measure labels. ('Real-time' view recognition is a company press-release description, not FDA-summary text.)
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI Assist provides Color Box and Doppler Gate placement for 12 Cardiac Views and 1-4 anatomy locations in each view, for a total of 42 supported placements.

embedded_ai_features.name: AI Measure
embedded_ai_features.function: Semi-automated cardiac measurements on B-mode, Doppler and M-mode acquisitions (15 measurement views in testing); comparison table maps it to eSie Measure on the SC2000 reference device.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI Measure covers a set of semi-automated cardiac measurements for Doppler, BMode and M-mode acquisitions.

embedded_ai_features.name: 2D HeartAI
embedded_ai_features.function: Machine-learning application on apical 2/3/4-chamber 2D images with user-editable output; K232145 tested it against 3-examiner manual contours/measurements (contrast used in 12 of 45 test exams); K260844 describes automated contouring of all chambers plus A2C/A3C/A4C view classification and adds right-side tracking (previously left side only). Comparison table maps it to Velocity Variance Mapping / eSie LH on the SC2000. Company materials additionally describe LV volume, EF and strain outputs; those are not itemized in the FDA summaries.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The  ACUSON Sequoia, Sequoia Select, and Origin will offer four (4) new software applications (AI Measure, AI Assist, 2D HeartAI, 4D HeartAI) containing Machine Learning that are specifically intended to support cardiac imaging for blood flow, valves and anatomical features and modifies the Indications for Use.

embedded_ai_features.name: 4D HeartAI
embedded_ai_features.function: Machine-learning application on 3D/4D TTE and TEE volumes (tested with 5Z1 TTE and 6ZT TEE) with user-editable output compared against 3-examiner manual contours/measurements; the FDA summary does not itemize its outputs. Origin only in K232145; extended to Sequoia / Sequoia Select with the 5Z1 transducer in K242523; comparison table maps it to eSie LH / eSie LVA / eSie RH + GLS on the SC2000.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The image dataset was collected from 32 patients from 5 institutions including different transducers (5Z1 (17 TTE), 6ZT (15 TEE)), Volume rates were > 13.4vps.

embedded_ai_features.name: Trace AI
embedded_ai_features.function: Semi-automated contouring/measurement of orifice-type structures (LV, RV, LVOT, LA, ascending aorta, MV annulus, STJ, LAA opening, sinus of Valsalva, TV annulus in testing) on MPRs generated from volumetric ICE, TEE and TTE transducers; the summary refers to algorithm training data, and describes it as an improvement of the generic eclipse measurement tool on K240704.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Trace AI is a semi-automated measurement tool that provides an ability to measure orifice-type anatomic structures on MPRs generated from volumetric ICE, TEE and TTE transducers.

embedded_ai_features.name: Valves AI
embedded_ai_features.function: AI-based mitral and aortic valve modeling from 3D TEE volumes: builds valve models, visualizes valvular motion and outputs valve measurements; previously cleared as eSie Valves on the ACUSON SC2000 (K233613).
embedded_ai_features.quote: Introduction of the new Valves AI feature, an artificial intelligence based application for mitral, and aortic valve analysis. The feature creates models that illustrate valve anatomy and function and provides visualization and measurements of valvular motion for assessing valve health. This was previously cleared as eSie Valves on ACUSON SC2000 (K233613).

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced the optional cardiac AI package on Sequoia / Sequoia Select / Origin: AI Measure, AI Assist, 2D HeartAI and 4D HeartAI (4D HeartAI and AI Assist on Origin only), plus Z6T and 5Z1 transducers and the AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE catheter; added the QIH product code. Reference device SC2000 (K211726) carried eSie Measure / eSie LH / eSie LVA / eSie RH + GLS.
notable_flags: Product codes on letter: IYN, IYO, ITX, OIJ, QIH
Separate AI test datasets reported per feature; training-set sizes not disclosed

clearances.changes_summary: Added Trace AI (semi-automated 3D orifice contouring on ICE/TEE/TTE MPRs); extended 4D Heart AI, AI Assist and the 5Z1 transducer to Sequoia / Sequoia Select; also added the non-cardiac AI Abdomen, 11M2 and HLX transducers, needle enhancement and freehand 3D.
notable_flags: Product codes on letter: IYN, IYO, ITX, OIJ, QIH, OBJ
Trace AI test set is small (10 patients, 24 volumes)
Intervening clearance K240704 (2024-07-22) carried the cardiac AI package unmodified and is not in this batch

clearances.changes_summary: Software VC10: integrated AI Assist and AI Measure workflow so that the cardiac view classified by AI Assist automatically launches the relevant AI Measure labels; other changes are non-cardiac (liver SWE optimization, UDFF attenuation display, OB calcs, workflow items). No AI performance data reported.
notable_flags: No AI performance metrics in summary
K260844 later cites K251481 as the clearance of 2D Heart AI, but 2D Heart AI is not mentioned in the K251481 summary

clearances.changes_summary: Software VD10: introduced Valves AI (mitral and aortic valve modeling from 3D TEE; previously cleared as eSie Valves on SC2000 K233613) and enhanced 2D Heart AI with right-side tracking; also TrueFusion (shares real-time anatomical data with an angiography imaging system to detect transducer position; previously cleared on SC2000 K233613), UDFF QUS optimization on 5C1/9C2, CEUS on Crystal catheters/Z6T/5Z1, and rendering/workflow items.
notable_flags: Product codes on letter: IYN, IYO, ITX, OIJ, OBJ, QIH
Valves AI reference standard is the algorithm's own auto-detection corrected by examiners, not independent manual tracing
2D Heart AI test set age range listed as 1-83 years while labelled 'Adults'; gender unknown for 63%

training_data.description: No FDA summary states training-set size, number of training sites or training demographics. Each summary states only that test data came from clinical sites different from the training sites (K232145, K242523) or that fresh data was collected for verification (K260844). The Siemens Origin press release refers to 'the world's largest cardiac image database' without a number.
training_data.source: K232145 p.15-19; K242523 p.14,16; K260844 p.13-14; https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/press/releases/acusonorigin

validation_data.description: Per-feature FDA verification sets: AI Assist 12 patients / 14 exams / 168 samples (K232145); 2D HeartAI 45 exams / 90 images (patients not stated), 5 institutions (K232145); 4D HeartAI 32 patients / 64 volumes, 5 institutions (K232145); AI Measure 32 patients / 392 images / 1354 samples, 5 institutions (K232145); Trace AI 10 patients / 24 volumes, 3 institutions (K242523); Valves AI 42 TEE studies / 86 volumes (patients not stated), 3 institutions (K260844); 2D Heart AI enhancement 48 patients / 96 images, 5 institutions (K260844). Countries: US, Mexico, Germany (Trace AI only). Patient totals are not summed because overlap across features is unknown; n_sites = the maximum per-feature site count.

prior_validations.description: Valves AI was previously cleared as eSie Valves on the ACUSON SC2000 (K233613, reference device for K260844); AI Measure maps to eSie Measure and 2D/4D HeartAI to eSie LH / eSie LVA / eSie RH + GLS on the SC2000 (K211726, reference device for K232145). Peer-reviewed evaluations of the SC2000 eSie Valves tool exist (see papers) but none of the Sequoia/Origin-cleared features.

Siemens ACUSON Origin product page (fetched 2026-09-05) lists accuracy figures for AI Assist (98% color box, 95% PW gate, 99% view classification/placement on 23 targets), AI Measure (89%), 2D Heart AI (99% LV EDV/ESV detection, 100% view classification, 98% GLS correlation), 4D Heart AI (96% LV ED/ES volumes vs 3 readers, 98% MPR alignment) and Trace AI (>95%). Footnotes cite internal Siemens reports; no n, comparator or study design is given, and the figures are not the same as the FDA-summary figures (e.g., FDA AI Assist 99.3% aggregated over all placements).

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for the Measurement of the Aortic Valve Annulus
papers.journal: Journal of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Anesthesia
papers.key_result: Siemens eSie Valves automated aortic valve software (SC2000 predecessor of the K260844 Valves AI feature) vs MDCT in 47 TAVR patients (SAPIEN 3): r = 0.84 (area-derived) and 0.85 (perimeter-derived); Bland-Altman 95% LOA -4.62 to 1.26 mm (area) and -4.51 to 1.45 mm (perimeter). Single-center, retrospective. Not an evaluation of the Sequoia/Origin implementation.

papers.title: Agreement between 4D transesophageal echocardiography and multi-detector computed tomography in measuring aortic root dimensions and coronary ostia heights
papers.journal: The International Journal of Cardiovascular Imaging
papers.key_result: eSie Valve semi-automatic 4D TEE aortic root measurements vs ECG-gated MDCT in 43 adults (prospective): strong correlation/good agreement for annular area, perimeter, derived diameters, left coronary ostial height, STJ and SoV minor diameters; moderate for right coronary ostial height. Predecessor tool on SC2000, not the Sequoia/Origin implementation.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Mitral Valve Analysis
papers.key_result: Inter-observer reproducibility of eSie Valve mitral analysis on intraoperative 3D TEE: 4 patients with normal MV, 36 end-systolic frames, 3 examiners; examiner had no significant effect on any of 6 parameters (mixed-effects ANOVA, Bonferroni P = 0.0083). Predecessor tool on SC2000.

papers.title: Dynamic Three-Dimensional Geometry of the Aortic Valve Apparatus - A Feasibility Study
papers.journal: Journal of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Anesthesia
papers.key_result: Feasibility of semi-automated eSie Valve aortic apparatus analysis on SC2000 / Z6Ms intraoperative 3D TEE in 10 patients with non-stenotic, non-regurgitant aortic valves; 13 of 45 exported parameters analyzed across the cardiac cycle. No accuracy comparator. Predecessor tool on SC2000.

open_questions: Training-set sizes, number of training sites and training demographics are not disclosed in any of the four FDA summaries.
K232145 2D HeartAI and 4D HeartAI: the Bland-Altman bias values (<5.2, <13.3) and the Pearson coefficients are not tied to named measurements (EF, volumes, GLS) or units in the summary.
K260844 Valves AI: the BMI-subgroup values (>=0.97, >0.88) are not attributed to a named metric; the reference standard is the algorithm's own auto-detection corrected by examiners.

K260844 2D Heart AI: the summary states the dataset was collected from 'Adults 1-83 years' and lists gender as 39% female / 61% male with 'unknown: 63%'; these internally inconsistent demographics are reproduced verbatim.
K251481 reports no performance data for the AI Assist view-classification-triggered AI Measure workflow; K260844 cites K251481 as the clearance of 2D Heart AI although K251481 does not mention it.
K240704 (2024-07-22), which carried the cardiac AI package unmodified, is the predicate of K242523 but is outside this batch.

Company accuracy figures on the ACUSON Origin product page (e.g., AI Assist 99% on 23 targets, 2D HeartAI 100% view classification) have no stated n, comparator or study; they are recorded with verification 'company' only.
Which product/version first shipped Valves AI outside the US and the SC2000 K233613 summary content were not reviewed this session.

No peer-reviewed publication evaluating AI Assist, AI Measure, 2D HeartAI, 4D HeartAI, Trace AI or Valves AI on Sequoia/Origin was found in PubMed (searches on each feature name, 'eSie Valve(s)', 'eSie LVA/LH/RH', 'eSie Measure', 'AcuNav Lumos', 'ACUSON Origin/Sequoia' + AI, 2026-09-05); the four listed papers evaluate the SC2000 eSie Valves tool that K260844 names as the prior clearance of Valves AI.
K232145 lists the 4D HeartAI TEE test transducer as '6ZT'; the Z6T transducer is what the same submission adds, so this is likely a typo in the summary but is reproduced as written.

Company product-page figures do not match FDA-summary figures for the same features (e.g., AI Assist color box 98% / PW gate 95% vs FDA 99.3% aggregated; 2D Heart AI view classification 100% vs FDA 98% average in K260844); the company figures cite internal reports that were not reviewed.
